verses.arabic: كٓهيعٓصٓ
verses.translation: Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.[806]
verses.footnotes: [806]- See footnote to 2:1.

verses.arabic: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
verses.translation: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
verses.translation: When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled[807] with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
verses.footnotes: [807]- Literally, "ignited." The spread of white hair throughout the head is likened to that of fire in the bush.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
verses.translation: And indeed, I fear the successors[808] after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
verses.footnotes: [808]- Those relatives from the father's side who would inherit religious authority.

verses.arabic: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
verses.translation: Who will inherit me[809] and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
verses.footnotes: [809]- Inherit from me religious knowledge and prophethood.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
verses.translation: [He was told],[810] "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
verses.footnotes: [810]- By Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) through the angels.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verses.translation: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
verses.translation: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."[811]
verses.footnotes: [811]- i.e., without illness or defect.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verses.translation: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.

segments.gloss: to go out, to come out, to depart, to leave

verses.arabic: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
verses.translation: [Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

verses.arabic: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.translation: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh

verses.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
verses.translation: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.translation: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to raise, to resurrect, to send

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
verses.translation: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
verses.translation: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

words.gloss: then he assumed for her the likeness
then he assumed for her the likeness

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
verses.translation: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًا زَكِيًّا
verses.translation: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
verses.translation: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verses.translation: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"

words.gloss: and so that We will make him

verses.arabic: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
verses.translation: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

verses.arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
verses.translation: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

verses.arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
verses.translation: But he[812] called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
verses.footnotes: [812]- There is a difference of opinion among scholars as to whether "he" refers to the baby or to the angel.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
verses.translation: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
verses.translation: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
verses.translation: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
verses.translation: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

verses.arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
verses.translation: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
verses.translation: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
verses.translation: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive

segments.gloss: to make, to instruct, to enjoin

verses.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
verses.translation: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.translation: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 1st person, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to raise, to resurrect, to send

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.translation: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.translation: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He![813] When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.footnotes: [813]- i.e., far removed is He from any such need.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

segments.gloss: to decree, to decide, to judge

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.translation: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."

verses.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translation: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

verses.arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded;[814] and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
verses.footnotes: [814]- i.e., "judged" or "accomplished."

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to decree, to decide, to judge

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.translation: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
verses.translation: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّا
verses.translation: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّا
verses.translation: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
verses.translation: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to refrain, to cease, to desist

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
verses.translation: [Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you.[815] I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
verses.footnotes: [815]- Meaning "You are secure" or "I will not harm you."

verses.arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
verses.translation: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke[816] my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
verses.footnotes: [816]- i.e., worship.

segments.gloss: to withdraw, to leave, to keep away

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural
segments.gloss: to call, to invite, to pray
to call, to invite, to pray

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
verses.translation: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

segments.gloss: to withdraw, to leave, to keep away

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
verses.translation: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.translation: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.[817]
verses.footnotes: [817]- A messenger (rasūl) is one who was charged by Allāh to reform society. A prophet (nabī) is one who received revelation from Allāh, the latter being more numerous than the former.

verses.arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّا
verses.translation: And We called him from the side of the mount[818] at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
verses.footnotes: [818]- Mount Sinai.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
verses.translation: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.translation: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
verses.translation: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.translation: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.translation: And We raised him to a high station.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا
verses.translation: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive
Active participle — accusative, masculine, plural, indefinite

verses.arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verses.translation: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil[819] -
verses.footnotes: [819]- Described as a valley in Hell or may be rendered "the consequence of error."

segments.gloss: to let go waste, to neglect

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.translation: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
verses.translation: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.[820]
verses.footnotes: [820]- Literally, "that to which all will come."

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verses.translation: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.translation: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
verses.translation: [Gabriel said],[821] "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
verses.footnotes: [821]- In answer to the Prophet's wish that Gabriel would visit him more often.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

segments.gloss: to be patient, to be steadfast

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.translation: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 1st person, singular, passive
segments.gloss: to bring forth, to drive out

verses.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verses.translation: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
verses.translation: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.[822]
verses.footnotes: [822]- i.e., fallen on their knees from terror or dragged there unwillingly on their knees.

segments.description: Verbal noun (masdar) — accusative, masculine, plural, indefinite

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّا
verses.translation: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.

segments.gloss: to take way, to remove, to withdraw

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
verses.translation: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verses.translation: And there is none of you except he will come to it.[823] This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
verses.footnotes: [823]- i.e., be exposed to it. However, the people of Paradise will not be harmed thereby.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
verses.translation: Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.

segments.description: Verbal noun (masdar) — accusative, masculine, plural, indefinite

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
verses.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"[824]
verses.footnotes: [824]- In regard to worldly interests.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
verses.translation: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
verses.translation: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to spread, to extend, to prolong

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
verses.translation: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord[825] for reward and better for recourse.
verses.footnotes: [825]- i.e., in the sight or evaluation of Allāh.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
verses.translation: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 1st person, singular, passive

verses.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.translation: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
verses.translation: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.

segments.gloss: to write, to prescribe, to ordain

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

segments.gloss: to spread, to extend, to prolong

verses.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
verses.translation: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions,[826] and he will come to Us alone.
verses.footnotes: [826]- Instead of giving him wealth and children in the Hereafter, Allāh will take from him those he had in worldly life at the time of his death.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

words.gloss: and he will come to Us

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
verses.translation: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verses.translation: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
verses.translation: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.translation: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.[827]
verses.footnotes: [827]- Of breaths, of days, or of evil deeds.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا
verses.translation: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

verses.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
verses.translation: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.translation: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.[828]
verses.footnotes: [828]- Not to worship other than Him.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا
verses.translation: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
verses.translation: You have done an atrocious thing.

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verses.translation: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
segments.gloss: to be near, to nearly do, to almost do

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا
verses.translation: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

segments.gloss: to call, to invite, to pray

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.translation: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًا
verses.translation: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.translation: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.

segments.gloss: to count, to calculate, to enumerate

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verses.translation: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.[829]
verses.footnotes: [829]- From Himself and from among each other.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
verses.translation: So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

words.gloss: that you may give glad tidings

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verses.translation: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
